magic_link_enabled.label: Magic-code login
magic_link_enabled.hint: Allow signing in with a one-time email code instead of a password.

refresh_token_expire_days.label: Refresh token lifetime (days)
refresh_token_expire_days.hint: How long a session stays signed in before requiring a fresh login.

enabled.label: Enable OIDC login
enabled.hint: Adds a "Sign in with…" button using an external identity provider.

provider_label.label: Provider label
provider_label.hint: Shown on the sign-in button, e.g. "Pocket ID".

redirect_uri.label: Redirect URI
redirect_uri.hint: Must match exactly what's registered with the provider.

from_name.label: From name
from_name.hint: Leave blank to use this instance's org name.

max_upload_bytes.label: Max file size (GB)
max_upload_bytes.hint: Leave blank or 0 for unlimited. Per file, not per project — see the storage limit under Instance.

stale_upload_timeout_hours.label: Stale upload timeout (hours)
stale_upload_timeout_hours.hint: Reclaim uploads stuck in progress longer than this. 0 disables.

stuck_processing_timeout_hours.label: Stuck processing timeout (hours)
stuck_processing_timeout_hours.hint: Re-dispatch a transcode that's been stuck this long. 0 disables.

soft_delete_retention_days.label: Trash retention (days)
soft_delete_retention_days.hint: Permanently delete soft-deleted items after this many days. 0 disables.

orphan_sweep_grace_hours.label: Orphan sweep grace period (hours)
orphan_sweep_grace_hours.hint: Only reclaim storage objects older than this. 0 disables the sweep.

orphan_sweep_delete.label: Actually delete orphans
orphan_sweep_delete.hint: Off just logs what would be deleted.

pipeline.label: Pipeline
pipeline.hint: Which hardware to use for encoding.

output.label: Output codec
output.hint: H.264 is broadly compatible; HEVC 10-bit is higher quality but heavier, especially on CPU.
